title: Tensor with globally strict-perfect coefficient sheaves preserves countable products
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme, and let $A_T$ be the ring sheaf of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Work in $D=D(\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\Proet},A_T))$, with the countable derived products of [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]. Let $E\in D$ admit a bounded complex representative $E^\bullet$ such that every $E^j$ is a direct summand of $A_T^{N_j}$ for some finite integer $N_j$. For every countable family $(C_n)_{n\geq1}$ of objects of $D$, the canonical comparison induced by the product projections
$$
(R\!\prod_{n\geq1}C_n)\otimes_{A_T}^LE\longrightarrow R\!\prod_{n\geq1}(C_n\otimes_{A_T}^LE)
$$
is an isomorphism, functorially in $E$ and the family.
